description: A React component for a modal dialog displaying team members, with functionality to invite new members and handle permissions.

classes.name: TeamMembersModal
classes.description: React component for displaying and managing team members in a modal dialog.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Calls onLoad callback if provided after component mounts.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by updating state.

methods.name: handleInvitePeople
methods.description: Opens the invitation modal and hides the current modal.

methods.name: handleExit
methods.description: Handles modal exit, focusing the origin element if specified, and calls onExited callback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal with team members list and invite button.
